common_steps: Confirm a dedicated disposable save and exact candidate/sidecar hash; preserve normal saves.
Run prepared preflight and verify fresh process/log identifies the expected unchanged baseline runtime.
Enable only the explicitly approved test sidecar, after static gates; do not enable a runtime candidate.
Record PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED with screenshot/video, observations, candidate identity and log timestamps for each check.
Save to a new test slot; exit the process completely; reopen and load that slot.
Capture postflight/crash evidence, disable the test sidecar and restore the original plugin list; keep the test save separate.

steps: Only after Opus supplies a parsed NIF, resolved textures, collision and an isolated ESP record.
Spawn the exact record using its recorded actual FormID; inspect front/back/underside in daylight.
Compare texture/material groups, axis/orientation and dimensions to source evidence and an FNV reference.
Walk into seat/back/legs from multiple directions; check intended collision gaps, ground contact and stability.
Reload and verify same bench transform/appearance/collision; remove via controlled test cleanup.

gates.name: Original textures and mask/shader adaptation justified

steps: After bench PASS, test Tool Gun, resolved Physgun model, crowbar, pistol, SMG1 separately.
Equip each from Pip-Boy; inspect first/third-person idle, walk, crouch, aim and weapon switching.
Inspect hands/grip, scale, clipping, textures and preserved intended sequence behavior.
Do not count candidate c_superphyscannon as exact Physgun until provenance resolved.
Record starting item identity/count; drop one item on clear ground.
Look at dropped item: correct model/name; pick it up and re-equip.
Transfer to container and back, then trade and reacquire where available.
Repeat after fresh-process save/load; verify identity/count and equipped usability.
Use only one approved catalog sidecar and the prepared representative batch.
Spawn recorded actual forms for rail/bench/ramp/crate or currently available equivalent entries.
Compare bounds/orientation to source and host reference; inspect surfaces/UVs.
Walk/contact each prop, inspect ground placement and intended static/dynamic behavior.
Remove test instances; verify clean reload.
Enable only REM_CombineArmor_Test.esp after static preflight.
Equip the exact test suit on supported male/female actors; inspect all intended body coverage.
Inspect idle/walk/run/crouch and normal weapon poses, first/third person.
Drop/pickup, transfer to NPC, save/load; record seams/clipping/material defects.
Do not replace Enclave/Remnants records or outfits.
Equip the persistent skateboard from Pip-Boy; inspect held view and dropped item.
Compare canonical geometry/material identity with Opus's validated skating assembly.
Record hand grip/orientation/bind-transform results.
Under-feet/mount/trick/exit checks remain BLOCKED until Opus assets and an explicitly authorized runtime integration test exist; do not activate skate mode merely to complete this packet.
